test_title: PYST 3: SSC GD Constable 2025 - English (Held On: 04 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence with an error in the adverb used.

options.text: They performed the task surprisingly well despite the challenges.
She had scarcely begun her speech when the microphone failed.
He spoke softly enough to avoid waking the baby.
The solution was applied so effective that it resolved the issue immediately.

solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. The solution was applied so effective that it resolved the issue immediately .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the given sentence is the use of the adverb "**effective**." The correct adverb should be "**effectively**."
 
• "**Effective**" is an adjective, whereas "effectively" is the adverb form that modifies the verb "was applied" correctly.
 
• To correct the sentence, replace "effective" with "effectively": "The solution was applied so effectively that it resolved the issue immediately."

Correct sentence: *The solution was applied so **effectively** that it resolved the issue immediately.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **They performed the task surprisingly well despite the challenges:** Correct usage. "Surprisingly" modifies the adverb "well."
 
• **She had scarcely begun her speech when the microphone failed:** Correct usage. "Scarcely" modifies the verb "begun."
 
• **He spoke softly enough to avoid waking the baby:** Correct usage. "Softly" modifies the verb "spoke."
